title: Tabata Burpees
creator: Izumi Tabata (protocol); community variant
description: Eight rounds of 20 seconds of burpees with 10 seconds of rest. The nastiest common Tabata: full burpees with a chest-to-floor and a jump, score the lowest round. Scale by stepping back instead of jumping.
